title: Wind of Purity

outfit_card.silhouette: A-tiered, empire-waist chiffon dress with a fitted bodice, voluminous sheer bishop sleeves, and a floating, handkerchief-hem overskirt that reveals a shorter underskirt.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate gold-tone circlet entwined with translucent white floral and leaf motifs with fine filigree branches.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: An off-shoulder bodice with a slim gold choker, featuring a central sunburst brooch of gilded filigree and rhinestones, and sheer organza bishop sleeves with metallic cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A layered skirt with a gradient hem from white to sage green, detailed with botanical embroidery, an asymmetrical sheer overlay, and a cinched waist with a leaf-shaped pendant.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating translucent feathers and ethereal leaf-like ribbons that trail from the waist and wrists.
